text: noor: Dropped a prototype for compact charts in the console: tighter x-axis ticks, unit toggle (auto/explicit ms/samples), and an option to "Show sentinel markers" for outliers. Need quick UX + a11y sweep. pete: Nice. My concern: axis ticks are getting cramped in narrow panels. We should avoid fractional tick labels like 0.125ms. Maybe a rounding policy based on magnitude. anya: Agree on rounding. Proposal: use smart units + SI suffixes (ms, s, K) and round to 2 significant figures by default. Add a secondary small-row showing the raw units on hover. noor: For legends in compact mode I tried collapsing long series names to initials with a tooltip. Looks dense but might be confusing for new users. Thoughts? a11y-team: Collapsing to initials loses context for screen reader users. If you collapse visually, make sure the full name is present in an aria-label and the tooltip is keyboard-accessible. Also ensure the legend is reachable via keyboard with role=tablist semantics. pete: For sentinel markers: design idea = tiny hollow ring with 2px halo, but if more than 4 sentinels in view show a single legend badge that says "5+ sentinels" instead of drawing all markers. Keeps chart legible. noor: Good. Also thinking to add a user setting: "Sentinel sensitivity" slider (70-99 percentile). Default 95. Make the label explicit: "Highlight top percentile (95%)". anya: Microcopy tweak: tooltip header should show "value (raw)" when raw overlay is on, and "value (smoothed)" when smoothing is on. For accessibility, include both values in the tooltip when both exist. infra-bot: Implementation note: expose `nativeUnits` and `displayUnits` on the chart payload, and `rawIndices` for sentinel mapping. Use an extra composited layer for markers. Cap markers at 6, fallback to legend badge. a11y-team: Live region suggestion for sparklines: a concise status string when focused, e.g. ``` Sparklines (p95 latency): min 2ms, median 12ms, p95 120ms. 1 sentinel above 95% at index 42. ``` a11y-team: Also recommend `aria-describedby` for the legend badge to include the sentinel count and a `button` with `aria-expanded` if clicking opens details. pete: Axis label suggestion: for very small numbers show micro-suffix "µs" instead of decimals. Also prefer SI formatting 1.2K over 1200. noor: Color accessibility: we added pattern fills for the percentile band (diagonal weave) when users have color contrast disabled or in greyscale printing. Will include token `warning-500` + pattern. figma-bot: Updated comp with smart-unit examples and sentinel badge states :white_check_mark: anya: Keyboard behavior: tab order should be legend -> sparkline -> sentinel focusable markers (if visible) -> details button. Markers must have 24px hit target using outline but remain visually 4px. Announce marker index and value on focus. noor: Acceptance criteria for the PR: smart units with 2 sig figs, explicit unit toggle, sentinel sensitivity control default 95, markers capped at 6 with badge fallback, aria-live summary on focus, legend collapse has aria-labels, pattern fill for non-color encodings, perf note for composited marker layer. pete: Tiny wording nit: use "Highlight top percentile (95%)" not "95th" in the settings UI. anya: I'll add the aria snippets to the component docs and run a VoiceOver test once the build is up. noor: PR: . I'll update the branch with unit formatting helpers and the sentinel cap. Ping me for final review. pete: :thumbsup:
